headline.text: L1 S1 *screw* found in sealed MM9 pouch at 09:14 — no hold or disposition documented.

summary: One HIGH severity event: metal screw found in finished pouch at L1 S1, status unknown. Three additional FM risks flagged today — broken filter pin at L1 S3, torn Sweco chute at L3 ML1, metal chips post-drilling at L1 S1. L3 checkweigher rejecting high volume of out-of-spec bags; L1 S1 X-ray detecting belt anomalies.

food_safety.title: Russell finex filter pin broke on S3 enrober
food_safety.summary: Broken pin discovered on food-contact enrober filter at shift start 07:51 — maintenance completed repair, no mention of recovering broken piece or verifying it didn't enter product.
food_safety.status: Repair complete, missing piece disposition not documented.

food_safety.title: Screw found in finished MM9 pouch
food_safety.summary: Nancy Quiroz discovered a screw inside a sealed pouch on Matrix 9 at 09:14 — no hold, investigation, or lot isolation documented in the window.
food_safety.status: Open, no disposition or hold documented.

food_safety.title: Metal chips on floor after conveyor drilling work
food_safety.summary: Metal chips found on blue belt area floor and structure at 06:17 after weekend drilling work — team immediately deployed sticky rollers before line start, passed ATP at 07:20.
food_safety.status: Resolved — area cleaned with sticky rollers, ATP passed, line released.

food_safety.title: Sweco rubber chute torn on ML1
food_safety.summary: Operator inspecting Sweco at 05:21 found torn rubber chute — torn elastomer in ingredient path is a foreign material source, no repair or replacement documented.
food_safety.status: Open, no repair or mitigation documented.

quality.title: S1 X-ray detecting belt anomalies, not product
quality.summary: Ishida X-ray rejecting pouches at 10:42 due to belt signal, not product contamination — Troy confirmed no metal in product but unable to resolve belt detection issue.
quality.status: Open, X-ray system anomaly unresolved, product confirmed clean.

quality.title: MF Matrix checkweigher rejecting high volume
quality.summary: Line throwing out lots of heavy and underweight bags starting 06:58 — maintenance called but had not arrived by 07:18, high scrap rate continuing.
quality.status: Open at window close, maintenance response pending.

quality.title: ML4 bars not demolding, visually out of spec
quality.summary: Product failed to demold at 07:23 due to temper issue — visually out of spec until 08:18 when good product resumed after temper corrections.
quality.status: Resolved at 08:18 — good product demolding, temper stable.

quality.title: ML4 bars with cream exposure on side
quality.summary: Two bars per 30-bar mold showing cream exposure at 11:46 — operator making adjustments, co-worker manually removing affected bars at line.
quality.status: Open, adjustments ongoing, defects removed at line.

sanitation.title: S2 heavy cream valve gasket leaking
sanitation.summary: Heavy cream valve gasket on Kitchen 2 leaking at 09:58 — maintenance requested to replace gasket, potential ingredient contamination risk.

sanitation.title: Trash separation failure in wash area 4
sanitation.summary: Trash can full of caramel and clusters instead of separated waste at 05:20 — coaching requested for EEs on waste separation protocol.

sanitation.title: S2 jar filling belt has chocolate residue
sanitation.summary: Chocolate buildup on jar filling belt noted at 07:31 — belt requires cleaning before next run.

sanitation.title: S2 water leak at combat boiler pipe
sanitation.summary: Water leaking from pipe to combat boiler at 11:31 — maintenance requested to tighten connection, sanitation zone integrity concern.

allergen.title: Almonds on pallet without label at ML1
allergen.summary: Almonds found sitting on chocolate pallet without label at 05:03 — Imperial operator flagged traceability concern, Isis investigating, no resolution documented.

opportunities.text: Consider adding broken-piece recovery and verification steps to food-contact equipment repair protocol — today's S3 Russell finex filter pin breakage had no documented recovery of the broken piece before restart.
Review post-maintenance FM verification checklist for drilling/metal-working — today's S1 blue belt area metal chips were caught by operators, not by a structured handoff inspection.
Add pre-shift Sweco inspection to ML1 startup checklist — torn rubber chute discovered mid-run at 05:21 could have been caught earlier with structured visual check.
Review MF Matrix checkweigher maintenance response time — high reject rate flagged at 06:58, maintenance still not on-site by 07:18 despite sustained scrap loss.
